name: The Underglow: Knowledge
source:
A black silhouette stretches below; your face is hidden by a missing mask. Coral light pulses through you as a silent current pulls you along. Before you can react, a figure in a white coat seizes you – and you become their test subject.

What does this Disciple want? Why you? And who are you? Swept into the Underglow, caught between knowing and peace, you must awaken… and choose who you are.

[From [url=https://pitch-drop.itch.io/underglow-knowledge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个黑色的剪影在下面伸展；你的脸被缺失的面具遮住了。当一股无声的电流牵引着你前行时，珊瑚光会在你身上脉动。还没等你反应过来，一个穿着白大褂的人抓住了你——你就成了他们的测试对象。

这位弟子想要什么？为什么是你？你是谁？被卷入暗光之中，夹在认知与平静之间，你必须觉醒……并选择你是谁。

[来自[url=https://pitch-drop.itch.io/underglow-knowledge]Itch.io[/url]]
